up: Retrieve all molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1821609'. For each molecule, provide the following columns: molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule name (pref_name), maximum development phase (max_phase), molecule type (molecule_type), and canonical SMILES. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID in ascending order.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS "ChEMBL ID", md.pref_name AS "Name", md.max_phase AS "Max Phase", md.molecule_type AS "Molecule Type", cs.canonical_smiles AS "Canonical SMILES" FROM docs JOIN compound_records cr ON docs.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1821609' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
